text:
Olivia: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread on release phasing for API, Console, and Optimize. I'll capture Qs here — ping leads directly if needed.
Simon: Quick Q — what's the exact gating for API v1 -> v2? Do we need an SDK freeze before console changes land?
Olivia: Gate = integration tests + latency SLO checks (p95/p50) + docs + migration guide. SDK freeze target = 1 week before Console flips the default to v2. We'll publish the migration guide early.
Matt: Is there an automatic fallback for customers still on v1? Need to avoid breaking traffic during flips.
Simon: Yes — routing supports a deprecation window. Existing API keys keep v1 as default for 60 days after flip; new keys default to v2. We also expose a 'force-version' header for temporary troubleshooting.
Tara: Can Eng share a checklist Product can track? e.g. api contract, typings, e2e, docs, telemetry hooks, canary plan.
Olivia: On it — I'll put a concise checklist in Confluence and link here by EOD.
Anya: For Optimize beta: opt-in or open launch? Also, what triggers rollback on quality regressions?
Simon: Beta is opt-in, initially limited to pilot customers (high-usage orgs). Rollback trigger = prompt-set delta + manual spot checks; automated rollback if top-line metric regresses >3% on primary prompt set.
Matt: Operational note: Dedicated customers will need a pin to previous quantization profiles. We should add an explicit UI control in Dedicated Console.
Olivia: Good call. Please include an example CLI snippet in the release notes for pinning.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary-api-v2 -> staging at 2026-03-22T14:05:03Z. 5/5 containers healthy.
Simon: Canary perf looks stable overall. Saw a 2% tail regression for long-context models; investigating kernel selection and kv-cache behavior.
Tara: Action items: 1) Olivia to publish checklist in Confluence; 2) Simon to share canary perf notes + diff; 3) Matt to draft Dedicated UI change for quantization pinning; 4) Anya to pick pilot customers for Optimize. I'll add these to the tracker.
Olivia: Thanks — I'll follow up in the PM sync and drop the Confluence link here.
Matt: One more: what's the docs versioning plan? Will we ship doc changes alongside SDK releases?
Olivia: Docs will be versioned per API major and per SDK release. We'll keep a stable v1 mirror for the deprecation window and highlight migration steps at the top.
Simon: If anyone wants the canary logs, ping me and I'll share the snippet for kernel traces.
Tara: SGTM. If no more Qs, closing the thread in an hour. :thumbsup:
